regime_context: The detector shows a defensive, healthcare-heavy leadership with Big Pharma as the confirming headline theme, while the top-ranked Memory/HBM theme is ineligible (trend gate off) — meaning no validated staying power despite the highest momentum score. Rotation view is 'narrowing' with low absorption, backtest verdict is 'discipline_not_prediction,' and the macro backdrop is AI/tech-dominated headlines with very high unscheduled-surprise share; the only validated edge here is the absolute-trend gate for drawdown control, so leans should be modest.
emerging_watch: Watching whether the top-ranked but trend-gate-INELIGIBLE Memory, HBM & Storage theme regains eligibility via the absolute-trend gate (durability_bar currently 0.33, breadth 0.0). If SMH crosses back to 'eligible true' with breadth expanding above, say, 0.4 while Big Pharma breadth rolls over from 1.0, that would retire the defensive-healthcare leadership read; until then it is a confirmed-non-confirmed watch, not a call.

theses.subject: Big Pharma
theses.thesis: Big Pharma is the confirming headline with eligibility (trend gate) on, durability_bar 0.85, breadth 1.0, and hurst_tag trend — the strongest combination of trend-health and staying-power legs among eligible themes. Crowding_z 1.48 is a size-down caution only, not a reason to fade. Momentum rank is a focus lens, not alpha, so this is a staying-power read, not a return forecast.
evidence: eligible true, durability_bar 0.85, breadth 1.0, hurst_tag trend
crowded true (crowding_z 1.48) — size-down caution, not a fade
theses.dissent: The crowding flag marks Big Pharma as a crowded late-trend theme; when breadth is already 1.0 and crowding_z is elevated, near-term upside is often limited and drawdown risk rises despite the trend gate.

falsifier.text: PPH lags SPY by 5% or more total return before the 30-day check-by date

theses.subject: Health Care (Equal-Weight)
theses.thesis: Health Care EW has eligibility on with high durability (0.81), breadth 0.933, and trend tag — a broad, cohesive healthcare continuation. Crowding_z 1.56 is elevated, so this is a size-down-tempered lean on staying power rather than a momentum chase.
theses.dissent: Extreme crowding in healthcare may coincide with a maturing defensive rotation; if the macro regime shifts back to growth/AI leadership, equal-weight healthcare could lag badly.

falsifier.text: XLV lags SPY by 5% or more total return before the 30-day check-by date

theses.subject: US Energy Complex
theses.thesis: US Energy Complex is eligible with a trend tag and — unlike most top themes — is NOT crowded (crowding_z 0.32, crowded false). The absolute-trend gate is the validated drawdown-control leg and energy passes it without the crowded-extension caution that plagues the leaders. Low breadth (0.091) keeps conviction modest.
theses.dissent: Breadth of only 0.091 and durability_bar of 0.50 suggest the energy trend is narrow and fragile — leadership may be concentrated in very few names and could reverse without broad support.

falsifier.text: XLE lags SPY by 5% or more total return before the 30-day check-by date
